pond.authority: Authored lined ornamental park pond; no natural-hydrology or drainage claim.
pond.water_mesh_domain: Only inside the water ellipse; bank terrain reaches exact water datum at the ellipse boundary. Remove/replace the original grass surface inside the entire outer bank ellipse.
pond.underwater_profile: q=sqrt((dx/5)^2+(dy/3)^2); z=-.92+.80*max(0,(q-.08)/.92) for q<=1. A tiny flat bottom inside q=.08, then a continuous sloped basin.
pond.dry_bank_profile: Along each ray, s=(radius-water_radius(theta))/(outer_radius(theta)-water_radius(theta)); z=waterZ+(existing_outer_z-waterZ)*(.4*s+1.8*s*s-1.2*s*s*s). Meet unchanged existing terrain at the outer ellipse; optionally round only within that envelope.
pond.terrain_preservation: All building pads and all existing 88 street/threshold profiles must remain unchanged; deformation support ends at the outer bank ellipse.

coverage_assessment.method: 0.25m area grid union of proposed crown discs, plus 0.5m route stations at center and +/-40% of width. Plan projection only; not solar shadow, ecological certification or final rendered canopy.
coverage_assessment.distant_woodland: No distant/background woodland is counted in park, plaza, court or route coverage.
gaps_and_intent: Compact frontage lanes have long canopy gaps where parcel and entrance clearances take precedence; planted courts and pocket shade provide the local refuge.
The seaside avenue keeps open sea views and narrow crowns in constrained inland verges; no false promise of continuous promenade shade.
Broad park crowns and two pond-side willows overlap portions of the loop and seating; use layered meadow/flower/shrub structure for ground-level richness.

Hydrangea and clipped hedge seams in sheltered courts
Fern and perennial flower drifts with mixed seasonal colour
Meadow daisies/coastal herbs and sparse marram/sea thrift above bare sand
